description: Builds and checks one task of a plan. plan-and-build runs it once for each task.

inputs.name: item
inputs.label: Task
inputs.description: A task of the plan, for example { "id": "t1", "title": "Add login", "details": "…" }.

inputs.name: check
inputs.label: Check
inputs.description: The shell command that proves the work, for example the tests.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: What the agent reports it did.

outputs.name: rescue
outputs.description: What the rescue did. Empty when the work needed no rescue.

nodes.label: Undo unfinished changes
nodes.command:
# Drop the changes a failed task leaves, so the next tasks start clean. Then fail the task.
git reset -q --hard && git clean -fdq
exit 1
